chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

He who is bestowed four things is not disallowed four things: he who is allowed to pray is not deprived of the response to it; he who is allowed to offer repentance is not deprived of its acceptance; he who is allowed to seek forgiveness is not deprived of forgiveness; and he who is allowed to be grateful is not deprived of furtherance of favours.
ai.seo_question: What are the four spiritual gifts that guarantee divine response according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith encapsulates the Shia theological concept of divine generosity (Fadl), where the mere possession of a spiritual faculty guarantees its successful outcome, reflecting the principle that God’s promise is more certain than human effort. It serves as a practical guide for believers, emphasizing that consistent engagement in du'a, tawbah, istighfar, and shukr is the key to unlocking divine mercy and sustenance (Ziyadah).

en.sayed-ali-raza: 135. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:

He who is bestowed four things is not disallowed four things: he who is allowed to pray is not deprived of the response to it; he who is allowed to offer repentance is not deprived of its acceptance; he who is allowed to seek forgiveness is not deprived of forgiveness; and he who is allowed to be grateful is not deprived of furtherance of favours.
